command_semantics: A read-only comparison script printed the Campaign258 v1 summary, then assumed the Campaign258 v2 delta ledger also contained an entries key. The v2 schema correctly uses delta_entries, so the script raised KeyError and exited 1.
disposition: Discard the failed command output as validation evidence. Read the known Campaign258 v2 structure without schema assumptions and model Campaign259 v2 as an immutable v1 predecessor plus two ordered delta_entries.
